before.requirement: Map text with CHARBOUND and STRIPCC while preserving the boundary marker of a grapheme that survives stripping.
before.reason: The old STRIPCC branch removes the negative boundary sentinel, so this preservation behavior is unavailable before the fix.

after.requirement: Map text with CHARBOUND and STRIPCC while preserving the boundary marker of a grapheme that survives stripping.
after.reason: The changed STRIPCC branch retains a surviving grapheme's sentinel, and reencoding emits it as a marker. No old harness map call combines CHARBOUND with STRIPCC.

claims.reason: The same frozen behavior is unavailable in the old implementation and supported after the change. The fixed old harness has no combined CHARBOUND|STRIPCC map route.
